paragraphs.text: DSH 插件：把 WorkBuddy 国内版/国际版的免费与付费模型接进 DeepSeek Harness。兼容分支：支持 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 ~ 0.2.1。
# DSH Workmate

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that puts WorkBuddy's model catalog into DSH — both the
international (`ww

w.workbuddy.ai`) and the domestic (`copilot.tencent.com`)
deployment, free and paid models alike. Th

e WorkBuddy desktop app is **not**
required: sign in from the browser, and the plugin keeps its own

per-region
credentials under `$DSH_HOME`.

- **Sign-in** — browser OAuth against the official CLI endpoints, one flow per
region. If a desktop

app is already installed and signed in, its credential
can be imported read-only instead.
- **Accoun

ts** — a separate account list per region, explicit switching,
remaining credits on the card, and an

optional note per account. The plugin's
credential copies never write to the desktop app's files.
-

**Daily check-in** — one action collects the daily check-in, the growth trip,
and every growth-cent

er task. Automatic check-in is available and off by
default.
- **Region isolation** — credentials, m

odel catalogs, and credit balances are
kept apart. Switching accounts only affects subsequent reques

ts; anything
already in flight keeps its original account.
- **No configuration required** — install
it, enable it, pick a model.
Supported host: DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` through `0.2.1`.
## Requirements

- Node.js 22.19+ or 24+
- DeepSeek Harness with the `web` profile
- A WorkBuddy account in either re

de.js 22.19+ or 24+
- DeepSeek Harness with the `web` profile
- A WorkBuddy account in either region

Then open **Settings → Plugins → DSH Workmate**, click **Connect**, and sign in
on the WorkBuddy pag

ettings → Plugins → DSH Workmate**, click **Connect**, and sign in
on the WorkBuddy page that opens.
Signing in from a terminal works too:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

**Restart `dsh web`** after installing, upgrading, or signing in. Reloading the
browser is not enoug
h — the host keeps the plugin's modules in memory.
## Choosing a model

With the default **free models only** scope, the picker lists exactly the models
that region's live

catalog currently prices at `x0.00`. Switch the scope to
**all models** on the settings card to see
the paid ones — those burn credits.
A default model can be pinned in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Use an id the region actually lists. The model list is whatever the live catalog
returns, so a hard-

coded default can go stale; `hy3` is free in both regions at
the time of writing.
## How sign-in works
Each region talks to its own auth endpoints, independently:

1. `POST /v2/plugin/auth/state?platform=CLI&nonce=`
2. Open the returned `authUrl` in a browser
3. P

oll `GET /v2/plugin/auth/token?state=` — pending requests answer `11217`
4. Store the token in that

region's plugin copy:
`$DSH_HOME/.workbuddy-ai-auth.json` (international) or
`$DSH_HOME/.workbuddy-c
n-auth.json` (domestic)

The desktop app's `workbuddy-desktop-ai.info` (international) and
`workbuddy-desktop.info` (domestic

) are opened read-only. The plugin only ever
writes its own copies, obtained through OAuth.

**Disconnect** and `logout` delete that region's plugin credentials only. The
desktop app is left al

sconnect** and `logout` delete that region's plugin credentials only. The
desktop app is left alone.
## Settings
Settings → Plugins → **DSH Workmate** exposes:

- **Connect / Disconnect** per region
- The account list for each region, with explicit switching, r

emaining credits,
a per-account note, and a connectivity test
- Domestic account selection and the a

utomatic check-in toggle (off by default)
- Refresh intervals — the active account every 15 minutes

and the others every
60 minutes by default
- Model scope: **free models only** (default) or **all mo

e others every
60 minutes by default
- Model scope: **free models only** (default) or **all models**
The same settings can be written into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Environment variables:
| Variable | Effect |
| `DSH_WORKBUDDY_AUTH_FILE` | Overrides the international desktop credential path. OAuth credentials

still go to the plugin's own file. |
| `DSH_WORKBUDDY_CN_AUTH_FILE` | Overrides the domestic deskto
p credential path. |
## CLI
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`status` and `doctor` accept `--json`. `logout` removes only
`$DSH_HOME/.workbuddy-ai-auth.json`.
## Compatibility

The seven `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer dependencies are declared as
`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.1 || >=0.2.1-0 <

0.3.0-0` rather than pinned to a single
release. DSH validates every `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer agains

t the running host
before it loads a plugin, so an exact pin rejects the plugin wholesale on any
oth

er host build. The second segment is what makes `0.2.1-rc.2` resolve —
prerelease tags do not fall i
nside a plain `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` range.

The `<0.3.0-0` upper bound is deliberate: a 0.3 host may change the plugin API,
and this package wil
l not claim otherwise.
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Fix |
| No card in settings, no WorkBuddy models | Restart `dsh web`. Reloading the browser does not reloa

d the host. |
| `dsh web` exits right after clicking Connect | On headless Linux without `xdg-open`,

upgrade to a build that handles spawn `error`; use the sign-in link shown on the card. |
| 403 `req
uest-not-trusted` when opening the card over a LAN address | Add that address to `allowedHosts`. Do

not add it to the loopback list. |
| Signed in but the model list is empty | The region's catalog re
quest failed or returned nothing. Check connectivity and whether the token is still valid — the list

stays empty rather than borrowing the other region's models. |
| `doctor` reports signed-out | Run

`login` first, or check that the international desktop app is signed in. |
| Paid models are missing
| Set the scope to "all models" on the settings card. Credits will be spent. |
## Disclaimer

For personal learning and research, driving your own WorkBuddy account on your
own machine. Follow t

he WorkBuddy terms of service. This project is not
affiliated with Tencent, WorkBuddy, or DeepSeek.
